title: UCIe Die-to-Die Adapter Retry: flits with CRC-16 and sequence numbers, Ack / Nak from the far side, a replay buffer resent on a Nak or a replay timeout

regs.name: TX
regs.desc: Payload to send; writing TX1 sends it (the Adapter takes it when the replay buffer has room and no replay is running)

regs.name: RX
regs.desc: Payload received; reading RX1 pops it. A payload arriving while RX is full is lost (RX_OVF)

fields.desc: flits sent and not yet acknowledged

irqs.name: CRC
irqs.desc: a flit with a bad CRC was received and dropped

irqs.name: REPLAY
irqs.desc: a replay started: a Nak from the far side, or the replay timeout

notes: lt_valid / lt_flit and lr_valid / lr_flit are the flit interfaces to the link; they pass through unchanged.
The core parameters RB (8) and TO (32) keep their defaults.
